name: freshdesk-mcp

tools.name: get_ticket_fields
tools.description: List every ticket field (system + custom) with its name, label, type and allowed choices. Call this before create/update/search when you need the API name of a custom field (e.g. 'cf_order_id') or valid dropdown values.

tools.name: get_tickets
tools.description: List tickets, newest first by default. Without filters Freshdesk only returns tickets created in the last 30 days (use updated_since for older ones) and caps results at 300 pages. Deleted/spam tickets are excluded unless filter='deleted'/'spam'. For field-based queries (status, priority, tags, custom fields, date ranges) prefer search_tickets. Returns { tickets, pagination }.

requester_id.description: Only tickets from this contact ID.

email.description: Only tickets from this requester email.

unique_external_id.description: Only tickets from the requester with this unique_external_id.

company_id.description: Only tickets for this company ID.

include.description: Comma-separated embeds: 'stats' (closed/resolved/first_responded times), 'requester', 'description'. Each costs 2 extra API credits.

tools.name: get_ticket
tools.description: Get one ticket by ID. The description and conversations are not always included by default; use include to embed them.

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.description: Create a ticket. Required: a requester identifier (email | requester_id | phone | twitter_id | facebook_id | unique_external_id) and subject/description. Common fields: subject, description (HTML), status, priority, source, type, group_id, responder_id, company_id, product_id, email_config_id, internal_agent_id, internal_group_id, tags[], cc_emails[], custom_fields{cf_*}, due_by, fr_due_by, lookup_parameter, parent_id (create as child), related_ticket_ids[] (create as tracker). status: 2=Open 3=Pending 4=Resolved 5=Closed; priority: 1=Low 2=Medium 3=High 4=Urgent; source: 1=Email 2=Portal 3=Phone 7=Chat 9=Feedback widget 10=Outbound email. Note 'type' is a top-level field, not a custom field. File attachments need multipart upload and are not supported here.

ticket.description: Ticket payload as a JSON object.

tools.name: update_ticket
tools.description: Partially update a ticket — only the keys you send change (status, priority, responder_id, group_id, tags, custom_fields, ...). status: 2=Open 3=Pending 4=Resolved 5=Closed; priority: 1=Low 2=Medium 3=High 4=Urgent; source: 1=Email 2=Portal 3=Phone 7=Chat 9=Feedback widget 10=Outbound email. Setting tags replaces the whole tag list. To change internal_agent_id/internal_group_id you must also send status.

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

tools.name: delete_ticket
tools.description: Move a ticket to Trash (soft delete). Reversible with restore_ticket.

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

tools.name: restore_ticket
tools.description: Restore a soft-deleted ticket from Trash.

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

tools.name: search_tickets
tools.description: Filter tickets with Freshdesk query language. Syntax: field:value joined by AND/OR with parentheses; strings in single quotes; numeric/date ranges with :> and :< ; null for empty. Fields: agent_id, group_id, priority, status, tag, type, due_by, fr_due_by, created_at, updated_at, closed_at (dates as 'YYYY-MM-DD'), plus custom fields by name (without cf_ prefix). Example: "status:2 AND priority:>3 AND tag:'vip'". Max 512 chars, 30 results/page, max 10 pages. Archived tickets excluded; index lags a few minutes. Returns { results, total }.

query.description: Query without the surrounding double quotes (they're added automatically).

tools.name: get_ticket_conversation
tools.description: List replies and notes on a ticket, oldest first (body, private flag, from/to emails, attachments). By default fetches every page so the full thread is returned; check 'truncated' in the result. Output: { conversations, total_returned, pages_fetched, truncated, next_page }; with fetch_all=false a single page plus pagination{current_page, next_page, prev_page, per_page}. Read this before drafting a reply so the response fits the thread.

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

fetch_all.description: Follow pagination until the last page (default true).

max_pages.description: Safety cap on pages fetched when fetch_all=true.

tools.name: create_ticket_reply
tools.description: Send a public reply to the requester (emails them). Payload: body (HTML, required), optional cc_emails[], bcc_emails[], from_email (must be a configured support email), user_id (agent sending). Use create_ticket_note for internal comments. File attachments (multipart) are not supported.

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

tools.name: create_ticket_note
tools.description: Add a note to a ticket. Payload: body (HTML, required), private (default true — internal, not visible to requester), notify_emails[] (agent emails to notify), incoming (true = appears as from the requester), user_id. File attachments (multipart) are not supported.

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

note.description: Note payload, e.g. { body: '…', private: true }.

tools.name: update_ticket_conversation
tools.description: Edit the body of an existing note (replies that were already emailed cannot be changed). Payload: { body }.

tools.name: delete_conversation
tools.description: Permanently delete a note/reply from a ticket. Irreversible.

tools.name: forward_ticket
tools.description: Forward a ticket by email to third parties. Required: body (HTML), to_emails[]. Optional: body_text, cc_emails[], bcc_emails[], from_email, agent_id, include_quoted_text, include_original_attachments.

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

tools.name: reply_to_forward
tools.description: Reply to a third party on a previously forwarded thread. Required: body (HTML), to_emails[]. Optional: body_text, user_id.

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

tools.name: delete_attachment
tools.description: Permanently delete an attachment (from a ticket, conversation, etc.) by attachment ID. Irreversible.

tools.name: view_ticket_summary
tools.description: Get the agent-written/AI summary attached to a ticket, if any.

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

tools.name: update_ticket_summary
tools.description: Create or replace a ticket's summary.

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

tools.name: delete_ticket_summary
tools.description: Remove a ticket's summary.

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

tools.name: get_field_properties
tools.description: Get one ticket field definition by API name (e.g. 'status', 'priority', 'type', 'cf_region'), including its choices. Cheaper to reason about than the full get_ticket_fields list.

field_name.description: Field API name. 'type' is mapped to 'ticket_type'.

tools.name: view_ticket_field
tools.description: Admin: view a ticket field with full configuration (choices, sections, portal settings).

tools.name: create_ticket_field
tools.description: Admin: create a custom ticket field. Required: label, type ('custom_text' | 'custom_paragraph' | 'custom_checkbox' | 'custom_number' | 'custom_decimal' | 'custom_date' | 'custom_dropdown' | 'nested_field'). Optional: label_for_customers, required_for_agents, required_for_customers, required_for_closure, displayed_to_customers, customers_can_edit, position, choices[], dependent_fields[] (nested_field levels), section_mappings[].

tools.name: update_ticket_field
tools.description: Admin: update a ticket field (label, required flags, position, choices…). Only sent keys change.

tools.name: delete_ticket_field
tools.description: Admin: delete a custom ticket field. Data stored in it becomes inaccessible.

tools.name: list_ticket_field_sections
tools.description: Admin: list dynamic sections of a dropdown ticket field (sections show extra fields when a given choice is selected).

tools.name: view_ticket_field_section
tools.description: Admin: view one dynamic section of a ticket field.

tools.name: create_ticket_field_section
tools.description: Admin: create a dynamic section on a dropdown ticket field.

choice_ids.description: Dropdown choice IDs of the parent field that reveal this section.

tools.name: update_ticket_field_section
tools.description: Admin: rename a dynamic section or change which choices reveal it.

choice_ids.description: Dropdown choice IDs of the parent field that reveal this section.

tools.name: delete_ticket_field_section
tools.description: Admin: delete a dynamic section from a ticket field.

tools.name: list_ticket_forms
tools.description: List ticket forms shown in the customer portal.

tools.name: view_ticket_form
tools.description: View a ticket form with its fields.

tools.name: create_ticket_form
tools.description: Create a portal ticket form. Payload: title (required), description, fields[] (required; must include the requester and company fields). Each field: { id (ticket field ID), label_for_customers, customers_can_edit, required_for_customers, placeholder_for_customers, hint_for_customers, position? }.

tools.name: update_ticket_form
tools.description: Update a ticket form's title, description or fields[] (same field shape as create_ticket_form).

tools.name: delete_ticket_form
tools.description: Delete a ticket form.

tools.name: clone_ticket_form
tools.description: Duplicate a ticket form (creates 'Copy of …' with the same fields).

tools.name: view_ticket_form_field
tools.description: View how one ticket field is configured inside a ticket form.

tools.name: update_ticket_form_field
tools.description: Update a field inside a ticket form. Payload: label_for_customers, customers_can_edit, required_for_customers, hint_for_customers, placeholder_for_customers, position.

tools.name: delete_ticket_form_field
tools.description: Remove a field from a ticket form (the ticket field itself is kept).

tools.name: bulk_create_tickets
tools.description: Undocumented endpoint (not in the public API reference) — may return 404 on some accounts. Create up to 100 tickets in one asynchronous job (same payload shape as create_ticket). Returns a job_id — poll view_job_status.

tools.name: bulk_update_tickets
tools.description: Update up to 100 tickets asynchronously. Payload: { ids: number[], properties?: {status, priority, source, type, group_id, responder_id, product_id, email_config_id, requester_id, parent_id, due_by, fr_due_by, tags, custom_fields, internal_agent_id, internal_group_id, skip_close_notification…}, reply?: { body, from_email? } }. Changing internal agent/group also requires status. Returns a job_id — poll view_job_status.

tools.name: bulk_delete_tickets
tools.description: Soft-delete up to 100 tickets asynchronously. Payload: { ids: number[] }. Returns a job_id — poll view_job_status.

tools.name: merge_tickets
tools.description: Merge secondary tickets into a primary one (secondaries are closed). Payload: primary_id, ticket_ids[], note_in_primary?{body,private}, note_in_secondary?{body,private}, convert_recepients_to_cc? (Freshdesk's spelling).

tools.name: list_archived_tickets
tools.description: Undocumented endpoint (not in the public API reference) — may return 404 on some accounts. List archived tickets (closed tickets moved out of the active list; not returned by get_tickets/search_tickets).

tools.name: view_archived_ticket
tools.description: View an archived ticket.

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

tools.name: list_archived_ticket_conversations
tools.description: List replies and notes on an archived ticket, oldest first. Fetches every page by default. Output: { conversations, total_returned, pages_fetched, truncated, next_page }; with fetch_all=false a single page plus pagination{current_page, next_page, prev_page, per_page}.

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

fetch_all.description: Follow pagination until the last page (default true).

max_pages.description: Safety cap on pages fetched when fetch_all=true.

tools.name: delete_archived_ticket
tools.description: Permanently delete an archived ticket. Irreversible.

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

tools.name: list_ticket_watchers
tools.description: List agent IDs watching a ticket (watchers get notified of updates).

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

tools.name: add_ticket_watcher
tools.description: Add an agent as a watcher on a ticket.

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

user_id.description: Agent ID to add as watcher.

tools.name: remove_ticket_watcher
tools.description: Stop watching a ticket as the API-key owner (Freshdesk only lets the current agent unwatch).

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

tools.name: bulk_watch_tickets
tools.description: Add one agent as watcher on many tickets (defaults to the API-key owner).

user_id.description: Agent ID; omit for the current agent.

tools.name: bulk_unwatch_tickets
tools.description: Stop watching many tickets as the API-key owner.

tools.name: get_associated_tickets
tools.description: List tickets associated with a ticket: children of a parent, or related tickets of a tracker. To create associations, pass parent_id (child) or related_ticket_ids/association_type on create_ticket.

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

tools.name: get_prime_association
tools.description: Get the prime (parent or tracker) ticket of a child/related ticket.

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

tools.name: list_ticket_accesses
tools.description: List user IDs (besides the requester) that were given access to view a ticket in the portal.

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

tools.name: add_ticket_accesses
tools.description: Give users (contacts) access to view a ticket in the portal.

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

tools.name: update_ticket_accesses
tools.description: Grant and/or revoke ticket access for specific users in one call.

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

tools.name: remove_ticket_accesses
tools.description: Revoke ALL extra user access on a ticket (requester keeps access).

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

tools.name: list_ticket_time_entries
tools.description: List time entries logged on a ticket.

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

tools.name: list_ticket_satisfaction_ratings
tools.description: List CSAT ratings submitted for a ticket.

ticket_id.description: Freshdesk ticket ID (the numeric display ID).

tools.name: list_ticket_enums
tools.description: Return the numeric codes Freshdesk uses for ticket source, status and priority. No API call.

tools.name: get_ticket_attachment
tools.description: Download and read one attachment from a ticket or any of its conversations. Images come back as viewable images, text-like files (log, txt, json, xml, csv, yaml…) as text, other files (PDF, zip…) as an embedded base64 resource. Get attachment IDs from the 'attachments' arrays of get_ticket / get_ticket_conversation. Max 5 MB (FRESHDESK_MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES).

ticket_id.description: Ticket ID.

archived.description: true if the ticket is archived.

tools.name: get_ticket_inline_images
tools.description: Return screenshots/images pasted inline in the ticket description and (optionally) conversation bodies — these are NOT in the 'attachments' arrays. Each image is labelled with where it came from (description, customer reply, agent reply, private note). Duplicates (e.g. from quoted replies) and tiny images (signatures, logos, tracking pixels) are skipped. The first content item is a JSON summary of found / returned / skipped images with reasons.

ticket_id.description: Ticket ID.

min_dimension.description: Skip images whose width AND height are below this many pixels (0 = keep all).

archived.description: true if the ticket is archived.

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (customers/requesters), optionally filtered by exact email, phone, mobile, company or state. Deleted contacts are excluded unless state='deleted'. For partial-name lookup use search_contacts; for custom-field queries use filter_contacts.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Get a contact by ID (name, emails, phones, company, custom_fields, tags…).

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Autocomplete contacts by the start of their name (fast, partial match). Returns id + name only.

tools.name: filter_contacts
tools.description: Filter contacts with Freshdesk query language (BETA). Syntax: field:value with AND/OR and parentheses; strings in single quotes; :> / :< for numeric and date ranges; null for empty. Fields: email, phone, mobile, company_id, twitter_id, language, time_zone, tag, active, created_at, updated_at (dates 'YYYY-MM-DD') and custom contact fields by name. Example: "company_id:42 AND tag:'vip'". 30 results/page, max 10 pages. Returns { results, total }.

query.description: Query without the surrounding double quotes.

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact. Required: name and one of email | phone | mobile | twitter_id | unique_external_id | social_handler[] (up to 10 Facebook/Instagram/X handles). Optional: other_emails[], company_id, view_all_tickets, other_companies[{company_id, view_all_tickets}], job_title, language, time_zone, address, description, tags[], custom_fields{}, lookup_parameter.

tools.name: update_contact
tools.description: Partially update a contact; only sent keys change (same fields as create_contact, incl. social_handler[], other_emails[], lookup_parameter). Setting tags, other_emails or other_companies replaces the whole list.

tools.name: delete_contact
tools.description: Soft-delete a contact (moves to Deleted; reversible with restore_contact).

tools.name: hard_delete_contact
tools.description: PERMANENTLY delete a contact and ALL their tickets (GDPR erase). Irreversible. The contact must already be soft-deleted unless force=true.

force.description: true = hard-delete even if not soft-deleted first.

tools.name: restore_contact
tools.description: Restore a soft-deleted contact.

tools.name: list_deleted_contacts
tools.description: List soft-deleted contacts (shortcut for list_contacts state='deleted').

tools.name: merge_contacts
tools.description: Merge duplicate contacts into a primary one; secondaries' tickets move to the primary and secondaries are deleted. Payload: primary_contact_id, secondary_contact_ids[], contact?{email, phone, mobile, twitter_id, unique_external_id, other_emails[], company_ids[]} to pick the merged contact's final values.

tools.name: make_agent
tools.description: Convert a contact (must have an email) into an agent. Optional agent settings: occasional, ticket_scope (1=global 2=group 3=restricted), group_ids[], contribution_group_ids[], skill_ids[], signature, focus_mode, type ('support_agent' | 'field_agent' | 'collaborator').

tools.name: send_contact_invite
tools.description: Email a customer-portal activation invite to a contact.

tools.name: export_contacts
tools.description: Start an async CSV export of all contacts. Returns an export id — poll view_contact_export until it has a download url. Use list_contact_fields to discover field names.

default_fields.description: Default contact fields to export, e.g. ['name','email','phone','company_name'].

custom_fields.description: Custom contact field names to export.

tools.name: view_contact_export
tools.description: Check a contact export job; when status is 'completed' the response includes the download url.

tools.name: list_contact_imports
tools.description: List the 5 most recent contact CSV imports (status, record counts, failure report).

tools.name: view_contact_import
tools.description: View a contact import: progress, completion estimate or failures.

tools.name: cancel_contact_import
tools.description: Cancel an in-progress contact import.

tools.name: list_contact_fields
tools.description: List all contact field definitions (system + custom) with names, types and choices.

tools.name: view_contact_field
tools.description: View one contact field definition.

tools.name: create_contact_field
tools.description: Admin: create a custom contact field. Required: label, label_for_customers, type ('custom_text' | 'custom_paragraph' | 'custom_checkbox' | 'custom_number' | 'custom_dropdown' | 'custom_phone_number' | 'custom_url' | 'custom_date'). Also required: agents_can_edit, displayed_for_agents, quick_add_for_agent, unique (booleans). Optional: position, required_for_agents, customers_can_edit, required_for_customers, displayed_for_customers, editable_in_signup, choices[].

tools.name: update_contact_field
tools.description: Admin: update a contact field; only sent keys change.

tools.name: delete_contact_field
tools.description: Admin: delete a custom contact field.

tools.name: get_agents
tools.description: List agents (support staff) with their contact info, ticket_scope, group/role IDs and availability flag.

tools.name: view_agent
tools.description: Get one agent by ID.

tools.name: view_current_agent
tools.description: Get the agent who owns the API key (useful as 'me', e.g. for responder_id).

tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Autocomplete agents by name or email prefix. Returns id, name, email — use it to resolve a person to an agent ID.

tools.name: create_agent
tools.description: Create (invite) an agent. Fields: email (required on create), ticket_scope (1=global 2=group 3=restricted; required on create), occasional, signature, group_ids[], contribution_group_ids[], role_ids[], skill_ids[], agent_type, language, time_zone, focus_mode.

tools.name: bulk_create_agents
tools.description: Create many agents in one async job. Each item: create_agent fields plus name, phone, mobile, job_title. Returns a job_id — poll view_job_status.

tools.name: update_agent
tools.description: Update an agent; only sent keys change (group_ids/role_ids/skill_ids replace the full list). Fields: email (required on create), ticket_scope (1=global 2=group 3=restricted; required on create), occasional, signature, group_ids[], contribution_group_ids[], role_ids[], skill_ids[], agent_type, language, time_zone, focus_mode.

tools.name: delete_agent
tools.description: Delete an agent: they are downgraded to a contact (their tickets are kept).

tools.name: list_agent_availabilities
tools.description: List all agents with per-channel availability: available, logged_in, assignment_limit, current_assignment_load, status, round_robin_enabled.

tools.name: view_agent_availability
tools.description: View one agent's per-channel availability and assignment load.

tools.name: update_agent_availability
tools.description: Update an agent's load settings: per-channel assignment_limit and/or availability_control.

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: List agent groups (teams tickets can be assigned to).

tools.name: view_group
tools.description: Get one group by ID.

tools.name: create_group
tools.description: Create a group. Fields: name (required on create), description, agent_ids[], auto_ticket_assign (0|1), escalate_to (agent ID), unassigned_for ('30m'|'1h'|'2h'|'4h'|'8h'|'12h'|'1d'|'2d'|'3d').

tools.name: update_group
tools.description: Update a group; only sent keys change (agent_ids replaces the member list). Fields: name (required on create), description, agent_ids[], auto_ticket_assign (0|1), escalate_to (agent ID), unassigned_for ('30m'|'1h'|'2h'|'4h'|'8h'|'12h'|'1d'|'2d'|'3d').

tools.name: delete_group
tools.description: Delete a group. Tickets assigned to it become unassigned from the group.

tools.name: list_admin_groups
tools.description: List groups via the admin API (includes routing/omnichannel settings). Prefer this on Omni accounts.

tools.name: view_admin_group
tools.description: Get one group via the admin API (with routing settings).

tools.name: create_admin_group
tools.description: Create a group via the admin API. Fields: name, description, type ('support_agent_group'|'field_agent_group'), agent_ids[], escalate_to, unassigned_for, business_calendar_id, allow_agents_to_change_availability, automatic_agent_assignment{enabled, type, settings[]}.

tools.name: update_admin_group
tools.description: Update a group via the admin API; only sent keys change. Fields: name, description, type ('support_agent_group'|'field_agent_group'), agent_ids[], escalate_to, unassigned_for, business_calendar_id, allow_agents_to_change_availability, automatic_agent_assignment{enabled, type, settings[]}.

tools.name: delete_admin_group
tools.description: Delete a group via the admin API.

tools.name: list_group_agents
tools.description: List the agents who are members of a group.

tools.name: update_group_agents
tools.description: Add and/or remove agents in a group without resending the full member list.

tools.name: list_canned_response_folders
tools.description: List canned response (saved reply template) folders with response counts. Start here to browse templates.

tools.name: view_canned_response_folder
tools.description: View a folder and the id/title of each canned response in it (no content).

tools.name: list_canned_responses
tools.description: List canned responses in a folder with full content (content_html, attachments).

tools.name: view_canned_response
tools.description: Get one canned response with its HTML content. Placeholders like {{ticket.requester.name}} are returned unrendered.

tools.name: create_canned_response
tools.description: Create a canned response. Required: title, content_html, folder_id, visibility (0=all agents 1=personal 2=selected groups), group_ids[] (required when visibility=2). File attachments (multipart) are not supported.

tools.name: bulk_create_canned_responses
tools.description: Create many canned responses in one async job. Each item: title, content_html, folder_id, visibility (0=all agents 1=personal 2=selected groups), group_ids[] (required when visibility=2). Returns a job_id — poll view_job_status.

tools.name: update_canned_response
tools.description: Update a canned response; only sent keys change. Fields: title, content_html, folder_id, visibility (0=all agents 1=personal 2=selected groups), group_ids[] (required when visibility=2).

tools.name: delete_canned_response
tools.description: Undocumented endpoint (not in the public API reference) — may return 404 on some accounts. Delete a canned response.

tools.name: create_canned_response_folder
tools.description: Create a canned response folder. Payload: { name }.

tools.name: update_canned_response_folder
tools.description: Rename a canned response folder. Payload: { name }.

tools.name: delete_canned_response_folder
tools.description: Undocumented endpoint (not in the public API reference) — may return 404 on some accounts. Delete a canned response folder.

tools.name: search_solution_articles
tools.description: Keyword search across Knowledge Base articles (title + body). Returns matching articles with category/folder names. Use this first when looking for help content to answer a customer.

tools.name: list_solution_categories
tools.description: List Knowledge Base categories (top level of category → folder → article).

language.description: Optional language code (e.g. 'fr', 'es', 'pt-BR') to target a translated version. Omit for the primary language.

tools.name: view_solution_category
tools.description: Get one Knowledge Base category.

language.description: Optional language code (e.g. 'fr', 'es', 'pt-BR') to target a translated version. Omit for the primary language.

tools.name: create_solution_category
tools.description: Create a Knowledge Base category. Payload: name (required, unique), description, visible_in_portals[] (portal IDs).

tools.name: update_solution_category
tools.description: Update a category (or its translation when language is set); only sent keys change.

language.description: Optional language code (e.g. 'fr', 'es', 'pt-BR') to target a translated version. Omit for the primary language.

tools.name: delete_solution_category
tools.description: Delete a category and EVERYTHING inside it (folders and articles). Irreversible.

tools.name: list_solution_folders
tools.description: List top-level folders in a category (with articles_count, sub_folders_count, visibility).

language.description: Optional language code (e.g. 'fr', 'es', 'pt-BR') to target a translated version. Omit for the primary language.

tools.name: list_solution_subfolders
tools.description: List subfolders nested inside a folder.

language.description: Optional language code (e.g. 'fr', 'es', 'pt-BR') to target a translated version. Omit for the primary language.

tools.name: view_solution_category_folder
tools.description: Get one Knowledge Base folder.

language.description: Optional language code (e.g. 'fr', 'es', 'pt-BR') to target a translated version. Omit for the primary language.

tools.name: create_solution_category_folder
